summary: Keep agents/market_priority_selected.py as the new locally preferred candidate: the six-day router plus the existing milk/wool sales adapter and milk/wool-first market ordering. Independent confirmation on eight fresh seeds produced 64 wins in 64 games versus 45 wins, 12 ties and 7 losses for the previous baseline across the same opponent panel; mean cash improved by 459.5 and mean match margin by 1001.6. Keep forecast-driven holding experimental: its margin advantage over priority alone was only +16.4 in natural discovery and -25.1 under controlled shops. The previous selected file is preserved.
limitations: Local evaluation against two public policy families and two derived behaviors; no leaderboard claim.
Priority reduced margin against the synthetic stockpiler by 195.6 on confirmation, though all 16 matches were still won.
The selected candidate uses fixed market ordering, not the opponent forecast.
